title: Cast iron
summary: Cast iron is a teaware material. Discuss observable behaviour: heat transfer, touch, odour, durability, cleaning and safety, not a single “breathability” claim.

title: 玻璃
summary: 透明、不吸味，适合观察茶叶舒展与汤色，常用于绿茶与花草茶。

title: Glass
summary: Glass is a teaware material. Discuss observable behaviour: heat transfer, touch, odour, durability, cleaning and safety, not a single “breathability” claim.

title: 瓷
summary: 高温烧成的致密胎体与釉面，不吸味、易清洁，是品茶与比较茶汤的常用材质。

title: Porcelain
summary: Porcelain is a teaware material. Discuss observable behaviour: heat transfer, touch, odour, durability, cleaning and safety, not a single “breathability” claim.

title: 银
summary: 导热快、外观亮泽的金属材质，常见于茶则、茶匙、壶与杯。

title: Silver
summary: Silver is a teaware material. Discuss observable behaviour: heat transfer, touch, odour, durability, cleaning and safety, not a single “breathability” claim.

title: 陶与炻器
summary: 烧成温度较高、胎体较致密的陶瓷，介于陶与瓷之间，手感温润。

title: Stoneware
summary: Stoneware is a teaware material. Discuss observable behaviour: heat transfer, touch, odour, durability, cleaning and safety, not a single “breathability” claim.

title: 紫砂
summary: 江苏宜兴丁蜀一带出产的一类含铁陶土，烧成后不施釉，胎体保留细小气孔。它适合做茶壶，但“吸味”“一壶一茶”是使用经验，不是夸大功效的理由。

title: Zisha Clay
summary: An iron-bearing pottery clay from the Dingshu area of Yixing, Jiangsu, fired unglazed so that the body keeps fine pores. It is well suited to teapots, but aroma retention and the one-pot-one-tea rule are working practices, not grounds for exaggerated claims.

title: 旅行茶具
summary: 为出差、旅行或户外泡茶准备的小型组合，重点是耐摔、易收纳和足够完成一次冲泡。

title: Travel tea kit
summary: Travel tea kit is about use and care: keep the object comfortable, clean and dry, and avoid thermal shock, stain build-up and bad storage.

title: 盖碗
summary: 由盖、碗、托组成的灵活泡茶器，既能做主泡器，也能直接饮用。白瓷盖碗中性、易观察，是学习冲泡和比较茶样的常用器具。

title: Gaiwan
summary: A three-part vessel with a lid, bowl and saucer, used both for brewing and for drinking. A white porcelain gaiwan is neutral, easy to observe and a practical tool for learning and comparing teas.

title: 煮水器
summary: 用于烧水的壶或炉，材质与控温方式影响水温稳定性。能稳定达到并保持目标水温，比追求昂贵材质更重要。

title: Kettle
summary: A kettle or heating vessel for brewing water. Stable temperature control matters more than expensive materials; safety depends on the material, heat source and handling.

title: 茶壶
summary: 带壶嘴、把手与盖的冲泡器，材质与器型多样，保温性通常优于盖碗。出水、容量和顺手程度比外观更重要。

title: Teapot
summary: A brewing vessel with a spout, handle and lid. Materials and shapes vary widely, and heat retention is usually better than a gaiwan. Pouring, capacity and comfort matter more than appearance.

title: 茶碗：建窑兔毫盏
summary: 茶碗是无需把手、可以直接饮茶或点茶的大口器。宋代福建建窑烧出的黑釉兔毫盏，把深色釉、厚胎与点茶时的浅色汤花放在一起，成为茶器史上辨识度最高的器形之一。

title: Tea Bowl: Jian Ware
summary: A handleless bowl for drinking or whisking tea. The dark-glazed Jian ware bowls of Song dynasty Fujian set thick stoneware and hare's-fur streaks against the pale foam of whisked tea, making them one of the most recognisable forms in tea ware.

title: 品茗杯
summary: 用于饮茶的小杯，口沿、杯身与材质影响香气与入口感受。白瓷便于看汤色，杯口光滑和圈足稳定比造型更重要。

title: Tea cup
summary: A small cup for drinking tea. The rim, body and material affect aroma and the first impression in the mouth; a smooth rim and stable foot matter more than decoration.

title: 滤网
summary: 放在公道杯或杯口，过滤碎茶与茶毫，使茶汤更清爽。

title: Strainer
summary: Strainer is one object in a teaware system. Form sets the action, material affects touch and heat, capacity changes concentration, and care decides whether it stays in use.

title: 茶船
summary: 茶船是茶器系统中的一类器物。器形决定动作，材质影响手感与导热，容量影响浓度，清洁方式决定它能否长期留在茶席上。

title: Tea Warmer

title: 水盂
summary: 水盂是茶器系统中的一类器物。器形决定动作，材质影响手感与导热，容量影响浓度，清洁方式决定它能否长期留在茶席上。

title: Waste Bowl
summary: Waste Bowl is one object in a teaware system. Form sets the action, material affects touch and heat, capacity changes concentration, and care decides whether it stays in use.

title: 公道杯
summary: 用于承接泡好的茶汤并分杯，使每杯浓度更均匀。容量、出水和断水是选择重点，玻璃或白瓷便于观察汤色。

title: Pitcher
summary: A vessel that receives brewed tea and divides it among cups so each cup has a similar strength. Capacity, pouring and cut-off matter; glass or white porcelain makes the liquor easy to observe.

title: 茶罐（茶入）
summary: 茶罐是存放少量茶叶或茶粉的小型容器，核心任务是避光、防潮、防异味和减少反复开封。朝鲜王朝时期烧制的粗陶茶入，曾随釜山倭馆的窑业进入日本茶事，说明这只小罐不只是厨房储物器。

title: Tea Caddy (Chaire)
summary: A small container for the tea or tea powder used over days and weeks. Its real task is to reduce repeated opening of the main pack, limit light, moisture and odour, and keep a modest amount of leaf close at hand.

title: 茶漏斗
summary: 把茶叶装入茶壶或茶罐时使用的漏斗，减少洒落并保护壶口。

title: Tea funnel
summary: Tea funnel is one object in a teaware system. Form sets the action, material affects touch and heat, capacity changes concentration, and care decides whether it stays in use.

title: 茶则与茶匙
summary: 用于取茶、量茶和将茶叶拨入壶或盖碗的小器具；材质从竹木到金属不等。

title: Tea scoop and tea spoon
summary: Tea scoop and tea spoon is one object in a teaware system. Form sets the action, material affects touch and heat, capacity changes concentration, and care decides whether it stays in use.

title: 茶巾
summary: 用于擦拭茶具、承接滴水的茶席用布；吸水、易清洗和不易掉毛是主要选择标准。

title: Tea towel
summary: Tea towel is one object in a teaware system. Form sets the action, material affects touch and heat, capacity changes concentration, and care decides whether it stays in use.

title: 茶盘
summary: 承托茶具、接住溢水，让泡茶过程保持整洁。

title: Tea tray
summary: Tea tray is one object in a teaware system. Form sets the action, material affects touch and heat, capacity changes concentration, and care decides whether it stays in use.

title: 英国骨瓷茶具
summary: 以骨瓷制作的英国茶壶、茶杯、茶碟与奶盅组合。骨瓷的透光、白度和强度来自胎料配方，不是“骨粉越多越高级”的简单排序。

title: English Bone China Tea Set
summary: 以骨瓷制作的英国茶壶、茶杯、茶碟与奶盅组合。骨瓷的透光、白度和强度来自胎料配方，不是“骨粉越多越高级”的简单排序。

title: 土耳其双壶
summary: 土耳其茶常用的上下双层茶壶：下壶烧水，上壶泡浓茶，出汤时按口味用热水稀释。它把“浓茶底”和“饮用量”分开控制。

title: Çaydanlık
summary: 土耳其茶常用的上下双层茶壶：下壶烧水，上壶泡浓茶，出汤时按口味用热水稀释。它把“浓茶底”和“饮用量”分开控制。

title: 茶筅
summary: 以竹材削成的点茶工具，用细密穗尖把抹茶与水打成均匀泡沫。茶筅不是搅拌棒，穗数、竹材与保养方式都会影响点茶结果。

title: Chasen
summary: 以竹材削成的点茶工具，用细密穗尖把抹茶与水打成均匀泡沫。茶筅不是搅拌棒，穗数、竹材与保养方式都会影响点茶结果。

title: 日本急须
summary: 日本煎茶常用的小型茶壶，常见侧把、短流与内置滤网。常滑朱泥急须是代表类型，但急须不是一个统一的器形。

title: Japanese Kyusu
summary: 日本煎茶常用的小型茶壶，常见侧把、短流与内置滤网。常滑朱泥急须是代表类型，但急须不是一个统一的器形。

title: 摩洛哥茶具组
summary: 摩洛哥薄荷茶常用的壶、杯、托盘组合。金属壶配彩色玻璃杯，以高冲倒茶，既是日常器具，也是待客礼节的中心。

title: Moroccan Tea Set
summary: 摩洛哥薄荷茶常用的壶、杯、托盘组合。金属壶配彩色玻璃杯，以高冲倒茶，既是日常器具，也是待客礼节的中心。

title: 俄罗斯茶炊
summary: 俄罗斯用于烧水和保温的金属器具，内部有加热管，常与茶壶、茶托杯一起构成家庭茶席。茶炊本身不是泡茶壶。

title: Russian Samovar
summary: 俄罗斯用于烧水和保温的金属器具，内部有加热管，常与茶壶、茶托杯一起构成家庭茶席。茶炊本身不是泡茶壶。
